method: Bounded read-only Firecrawl scrape of public landing pages; no interaction, authentication, form submission, or applicant data collection.
limitations: Each observation proves only what the named public URL returned at the observation time. It is not a completeness crawl and does not establish current eligibility or deadline facts.

observations.observed: The current landing page presents three separately named scholarship opportunities and states that one unified application serves them.
The current landing page routes visitors to undergraduate, career and technical, and graduate scholarship program sections with separate application periods.

The public page exposes multiple scholarship discovery sections and a Montana scholarship directory. The sheet's one-application/multiple-awards claim was not independently reproduced without entering an application workflow.
The public landing page returned an opportunities table with separately linked award pages and current displayed status values of Ended in the inspected result slice.
FIRST directs students to a Pearson scholarship portal and states that individual providers fund and administer awards with distinct terms and application processes.
The public program page identifies two collegiate scholarships, a general application, selection of either or both funds, and program-specific follow-up questions.
The current page lists multiple separately named scholarships and says applications are available through the school counseling office.
